content: Relevance of attribute TextTableMapping . mappingDirec- tion in an aggregation by SenderReceiverToSignalMapping The value of at- tributes • SenderReceiverToSignalMapping . senderToSignalTextTableMap- ping . mappingDirection • SenderReceiverToSignalMapping . signalToReceiverTextTableMap- ping . mappingDirection has no meaning and shall be ignored.
